title: all: Adaptation on openharmony/arm64 platform.
body:
需求价值】：
支持使用go语言开发的软件在openharmony/arm64上运行。

【需求描述】：
为go语言添加一种新的目标操作系统：openharmony，仅在arm64架构上支持；通过交叉编译的方式支持，编译机器为Linux/x86。

【方案描述】：
1、引入GOOS=openharmony标志目标操作系统为openharmony的情况。
2、当GOOS=openharmony时，会匹配命中"linux" build tag，就像当GOOS=android时会匹配命中"linux" build tag和当GOOS=illumos时匹配命中"solaris" build tag一样。
3、对于源码中的GOOS=="linux"，大部分需要修改为 (GOOS=="linux" || GOOS="openharmony")；当openharmony系统和linux系统在很多地方是存在差别的，仅在openharmony上有效的分支使用 GOOS=="openharmony"作为if语句的条件。
4、当前仅支持在Linux/x86上通过交叉编译的方式支持openharmony/arm64。
5、通过环境变量指定 GOOS="openharmony" GOARCH="arm64"生成openharmony/arm64目标文件。

【配套文档】：
1、golang/go基线版本：go1.24。
2、使用方式：交叉编译；编译机器：Linux/x86；目标机器：openharmony/arm64。
3、openharmony系统版本：OpenHarmony v5.0.0 Release以上版本，不支持更早的版本。
4、cgo配套C编译器版本信息：

OHOS (dev) clang version 15.0.4 (llvm-project ef33c3575763937746833063de4d2e1fd184bbf7)
Target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

C编译工具链下载地址：https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/download/

【验收标准】：
使用当前go编译器可以编译出openharmony/arm64目标文件，可以在openharmony/arm64上稳定运行且功能正常。

【遗留问题】：
当前有部分测试用例因系统差异无法通过，我们将在后续的合入中对这部分用例进行适配。

title: archive/tar: set a limit on the size of GNU sparse file 1.0 regions
body:
archive/tar: set a limit on the size of GNU sparse file 1.0 regions


Sparse files in tar archives contain only the non-zero components
of the file. There are several different encodings for sparse
files. When reading GNU tar pax 1.0 sparse files, archive/tar did
not set a limit on the size of the sparse region data. A malicious
archive containing a large number of sparse blocks could cause
archive/tar to read an unbounded amount of data from the archive
into memory.

Since a malicious input can be highly compressable, a small
compressed input could cause very large allocations.

Cap the size of the sparse block data to the same limit used
for PAX headers (1 MiB).

Thanks to Harshit Gupta (Mr HAX) (https://www.linkedin.com/in/iam-harshit-gupta/)
for reporting this issue.

Fixes CVE-2025-58183
For #75677

title: encoding/pem: make Decode complexity linear
body:
encoding/pem: make Decode complexity linear


Because Decode scanned the input first for the first BEGIN line, and
then the first END line, the complexity of Decode is quadratic. If the
input contained a large number of BEGINs and then a single END right at
the end of the input, we would find the first BEGIN, and then scan the
entire input for the END, and fail to parse the block, so move onto the
next BEGIN, scan the entire input for the END, etc.

Instead, look for the first END in the input, and then the first BEGIN
that precedes the found END. We then process the bytes between the BEGIN
and END, and move onto the bytes after the END for further processing.
This gives us linear complexity.

Fixes CVE-2025-61723
For #75676
Fixes #75708

title: encoding/asn1: prevent memory exhaustion when parsing using internal/saferio
body:
encoding/asn1: prevent memory exhaustion when parsing using internal/saferio


Within parseSequenceOf, reflect.MakeSlice is being used to pre-allocate
a slice that is needed in order to fully validate the given DER payload.
The size of the slice allocated are also multiple times larger than the
input DER:

- When using asn1.Unmarshal directly, the allocated slice is ~28x
  larger.
- When passing in DER using x509.ParseCertificateRequest, the allocated
  slice is ~48x larger.
- When passing in DER using ocsp.ParseResponse, the allocated slice is
  ~137x larger.

As a result, a malicious actor can craft a big empty DER payload,
resulting in an unnecessary large allocation of memories. This can be a
way to cause memory exhaustion.

To prevent this, we now use SliceCapWithSize within internal/saferio to
enforce a memory allocation cap.

Thanks to Jakub Ciolek for reporting this issue.

For #75671
Fixes #75704
Fixes CVE-2025-58185

title: net/http: add httpcookiemaxnum GODEBUG option to limit number of cookies parsed
body:
net/http: add httpcookiemaxnum GODEBUG option to limit number of cookies parsed


When handling HTTP headers, net/http does not currently limit the number
of cookies that can be parsed. The only limitation that exists is for
the size of the entire HTTP header, which is controlled by
MaxHeaderBytes (defaults to 1 MB).

Unfortunately, this allows a malicious actor to send HTTP headers which
contain a massive amount of small cookies, such that as much cookies as
possible can be fitted within the MaxHeaderBytes limitation. Internally,
this causes us to allocate a massive number of Cookie struct.

For example, a 1 MB HTTP header with cookies that repeats "a=;" will
cause an allocation of ~66 MB in the heap. This can serve as a way for
malicious actors to induce memory exhaustion.

To fix this, we will now limit the number of cookies we are willing to
parse to 3000 by default. This behavior can be changed by setting a new
GODEBUG option: GODEBUG=httpcookiemaxnum. httpcookiemaxnum can be set to
allow a higher or lower cookie limit. Setting it to 0 will also allow an
infinite number of cookies to be parsed.

Thanks to jub0bs for reporting this issue.

For #75672
Fixes #75706
Fixes CVE-2025-58186

title: crypto/x509: improve domain name verification
body:
crypto/x509: improve domain name verification
Don't use domainToReverseLabels to check if domain names are valid,
since it is not particularly performant, and can contribute to DoS
vectors. Instead just iterate over the name and enforce the properties
we care about.

This also enforces that DNS names, both in SANs and name constraints,
are valid. We previously allowed invalid SANs, because some
intermediates had these weird names (see #23995), but there are
currently no trusted intermediates that have this property, and since we
target the web PKI, supporting this particular case is not a high
priority.

Thank you to Jakub Ciolek for reporting this issue.

  square brackets.
- RFC 3986 stipulates that only IPv6 hostnames can be embedded within
  square brackets in a URL.
- Now, the parsing logic should strictly enforce that only IPv6
  hostnames can be resolved when in square brackets. IPv4, IPv4-mapped
  addresses and other input will be rejected.
- Update url_test to add test cases that cover the above scenarios.

Thanks to Enze Wang, Jingcheng Yang and Zehui Miao of Tsinghua
University for reporting this issue.

title: database/sql: avoid closing Rows while scan is in progress
body:
[release-branch.go1.24] database/sql: avoid closing Rows while scan is in progress

A database/sql/driver.Rows can return database-owned data
from Rows.Next. The driver.Rows documentation doesn't explicitly
document the lifetime guarantees for this data, but a reasonable
expectation is that the caller of Next should only access it
until the next call to Rows.Close or Rows.Next.

Avoid violating that constraint when a query is cancelled while
a call to database/sql.Rows.Scan (note the difference between
the two different Rows types!) is in progress. We previously
took care to avoid closing a driver.Rows while the user has
access to driver-owned memory via a RawData, but we could still
close a driver.Rows while a Scan call was in the process of
reading previously-returned driver-owned data.

Update the fake DB used in database/sql tests to invalidate
returned data to help catch other places we might be
incorrectly retaining it.

Updates #74831
Fixes #74833

title: runtime: move SP to make sure __tlsdesc-stub does not overwrite FP saved at SP-8
body:
运行编译器用例 TestSignalHandlersWithNotify 运行时失败。
定位后发现奔溃点在 entersyscallblock 函数内部，执行完 systemstack(entersyscallblock_handoff) 之后 再调用getcallerfp()时奔溃。

查看 getcallerfp() 函数的实现逻辑，是从 SP-8的位置获取FP的值，gdb单步调试发现这个对应的值在systemstack(entersyscallblock_handoff) 里面执行 save_g函数的时候被破坏了，进一步调试发现破坏的点在 获取tls线程局部变量的函数里面。由于这个用例测试的是c-shared编译模式，所以这里获取tls本地变量用的是musl标准库里的函数，而musl标准库中在动态库模式下获取tls的函数的第一条指令就是 stp x1,x2, \[sp, #-16]。这里就把FP的值破话掉了，导致如果在这之后在尝试获取FP的值，就会奔溃。

于是我们想到一个解决办法：在c-shared模式下，调用 获取 tls的函数之前先把SP的值减去16，调用完毕再加回来，这样就可以避免在获取tls的时候FP被破坏了。

cmd/asm,cmd/link,cmd/go: Add dynamic TLS model for ARM64

Add a flag -tls=[IE,LE,GD] in the asm tool to specify tls model. Pass two flags from cmd/go for the c-shared mode for supporting targets (currently only ARM64): -D=TLS_GD -tls=GD. Update test runner under internal/testdir with a new test run option: objcheck. Update cmd/link with a new relocation type R_ARM64_TLS_GD which relies on external linker relocations, similar to existing R_ARM64_TLS_IE.

The general dynamic TLS model uses a stub call, and we pass additional preprocessor flag to assembler to handle cases without a stack frame (to allow it temporarily keep the return address in some register). The new objcheck test option is similar to asmcheck, but uses 'go tool objdump' on the go object file instead of checking assembly. This allows writing specific tests for relocations emitted in the object file. Added three testcases for the new -tls option.

title: runtime: fix segfault due to missing argv on musl-linux c-archive
body:
runtime: fix segfault due to missing argv on musl-linux c-archive

This change fixes a segmentation fault that occurs on musl-based systems
when using c-archive (or c-shared with LD_PRELOAD). The issue was caused
by uninitialized argv and envp, which led to crashes at runtime.

This fix ensures that both argv and envp are correctly initialized,
preventing the segmentation fault.

While this fix addresses crashes due to missing argv and envp, it does not
address the error described in issue #54805, where a c-shared library
loaded with dlopen triggers an error related to initial-exec access to TLS
objects [1] in a dynamically loaded library.

title: proposal: all: support openharmony/arm64
body:
需求价值】：
支持使用go语言开发的软件在openharmony/arm64上运行。

【需求描述】：
为go语言添加一种新的目标操作系统：openharmony，仅在arm64架构上支持；通过交叉编译的方式支持，编译机器为Linux/x86。

【方案描述】：
1、引入GOOS=openharmony标志目标操作系统为openharmony的情况。
2、当GOOS=openharmony时，会匹配命中"linux" build tag，就像当GOOS=android时会匹配命中"linux" build tag和当GOOS=illumos时匹配命中"solaris" build tag一样。
3、对于源码中的GOOS=="linux"，大部分需要修改为 (GOOS=="linux" || GOOS="openharmony")；当openharmony系统和linux系统在很多地方是存在差别的，仅在openharmony上有效的分支使用 GOOS=="openharmony"作为if语句的条件。
4、当前仅支持在Linux/x86上通过交叉编译的方式支持openharmony/arm64。
5、通过环境变量指定 GOOS="openharmony" GOARCH="arm64"生成openharmony/arm64目标文件。

【配套文档】：
1、golang/go基线版本：go1.24。
2、使用方式：交叉编译；编译机器：Linux/x86；目标机器：openharmony/arm64。
3、openharmony系统版本：OpenHarmony v5.0.0 Release以上版本，不支持更早的版本。
4、cgo配套C编译器版本信息：

OHOS (dev) clang version 15.0.4 (llvm-project ef33c3575763937746833063de4d2e1fd184bbf7)
Target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

C编译工具链下载地址：https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/download/

【验收标准】：
使用当前go编译器可以编译出openharmony/arm64目标文件，可以在openharmony/arm64上稳定运行且功能正常。

【遗留问题】：
当前有部分测试用例因系统差异无法通过，我们将在后续的合入中对这部分用例进行适配。

title: runtime: skip registration error for 43 sig
body:
**【任务描述】**
openharmony系统上存在43信号被占用的情况，而go运行时启动时会尝试给给43信号注册一个处理函数，如果43信号已经被占用的情况下go运行时再去注册，就会导致运行时启动失败，go程序退出，因此在openharmony系统上，如果遇到43信号处理函数注册失败的问题，直接跳过，进行后续的步骤。

**【解决方案】**
1、运行时启动时尝试给43信号注册回调函数，若注册成功，则正常往下走，流程与之前一致。
2、若注册失败，则说明43信号被占用了，则跳过该信号的注册流程。

**【任务来源】**
openharmony适配

title: proposal: all: use runtime.IsOpenharmony instead of runtime.GOOS=="openharmony"
body:
**【需求价值】：**
背景：
在这个PR https://gitee.com/openharmony-sig/ohos_golang_go/pulls/2 之后，我们可以通过runtime.GOOS=="openharmony"的值来判断当前的操作系统是否是openharmony，在这个PR中，我们在很多处做了这样的修改：把runtime.GOOS == "linux" 修改为 runtime.GOOS == "linux" || runtime.GOOS == "openharmony"。这是因为多数情况下openharmony和linux应该走同一个分支。除了编译器和运行时，在很多流行的go语言开源软件中也有这样的条件判断，这就导致，如果我们开发的go应用程序依赖了这些开源软件并且我们想在openharmony上运行这个go应用，我们就需要对这些开源软件做上述同样的修改。对go三方开源软件进行侵入式修改一是工作量比较大，二是开源软件升级维护困难。为了方便开发者快速构建openharmony go应用或将go应用从linux迁移到openharmony，我们决定对之前的方案作出如下改动：（1）当编译目标系统为openharmony时，runtime.GOOS的值由原来的"openhamrony" 修改为 "linux"；（2）新增runtime.IsOpenharmony用于确认当前系统是否为openharmony系统。这样，对于大多数的开源软件，我们无需做侵入式修改即可在openharmony上使用，同时对于openharmony系统的特定适配，我们可以使用runtime.IsOpenharmony来完成。

价值：
大多数在linux上流行的go开源软件可以不用做任何修改，直接在openharmony上使用。

**【需求描述】：**
1、当编译目标系统为openharmony时，runtime.GOOS的值由原来的"openharmony"修改为"linux"。
2、新增runtime.IsOpenharmony API，用于openharmony系统特定的适配。

**【方案描述】：**
1、修改zgoos_openharmony.go文件，将 GOOS=`openharmony` 修改为 GOOS=`linux`。
2、回退上个PR的修改，将 runtime.GOOS == "linux" || runtime.GOOS == "openharmony" 回退为 runtime.GOOS == "linux"。
3、openharmony特定逻辑使用runtime.IsOpenharmony来判断，将 runtime.GOOS == "openharmony" 修改为 runtime.IsOpenharmony。
4、使用当前编译器编译openharmony go应用时操作流程不变，依旧使用环境变量指定GOOS="openharmony" GOARCH="arm64"。

**【配套文档】：**
1、golang/go基线版本：go1.22。
2、使用方式：交叉编译；编译机器：Linux/x86；目标机器：openharmony/arm64。
3、openharmony系统版本：OpenHarmony v5.0.0 Release以上版本，不支持更早的版本。
4、cgo配套C编译器版本信息：

OHOS (dev) clang version 15.0.4 (llvm-project ef33c3575763937746833063de4d2e1fd184bbf7)
Target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
C编译工具链下载地址：https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/download/
**【验收标准】：**
使用当前go编译器可以编译出openharmony/arm64目标文件，可以在openharmony/arm64上稳定运行且功能正常。

title: proposal: all: support openharmony/arm64
body:
**【需求价值】：**
支持使用go语言开发的软件在openharmony/arm64上运行。

**【需求描述】：**
为go语言添加一种新的目标操作系统：openharmony，仅在arm64架构上支持；通过交叉编译的方式支持，编译机器为Linux/x86。

**【方案描述】：**
1、引入GOOS=openharmony标志目标操作系统为openharmony的情况。
2、当GOOS=openharmony时，会匹配命中"linux" build tag，就像当GOOS=android时会匹配命中"linux" build tag和当GOOS=illumos时匹配命中"solaris" build tag一样。
3、对于源码中的GOOS=="linux"，大部分需要修改为 (GOOS=="linux" || GOOS="openharmony")；当openharmony系统和linux系统在很多地方是存在差别的，仅在openharmony上有效的分支使用 GOOS=="openharmony"作为if语句的条件。
4、当前仅支持在Linux/x86上通过交叉编译的方式支持openharmony/arm64。
5、通过环境变量指定 GOOS="openharmony" GOARCH="arm64"生成openharmony/arm64目标文件。

**【配套文档】：**
1、golang/go基线版本：go1.22。
2、使用方式：交叉编译；编译机器：Linux/x86；目标机器：openharmony/arm64。
3、openharmony系统版本：OpenHarmony v5.0.0 Release以上版本，不支持更早的版本。
4、cgo配套C编译器版本信息：
```
OHOS (dev) clang version 15.0.4 (llvm-project ef33c3575763937746833063de4d2e1fd184bbf7)
Target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
```
C编译工具链下载地址：https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/download/


**【验收标准】：**
使用当前go编译器可以编译出openharmony/arm64目标文件，可以在openharmony/arm64上稳定运行且功能正常。

**【遗留问题】：**
当前有部分测试用例因系统差异无法通过，我们将在后续的合入中对这部分用例进行适配。
